$comment: Catalog v8 (2026-07-31, per Bri's balance pass) — 11 items, all prices globally unique so any revealed amount identifies the item. One saving item: the barrel of beer (45) beats everything including the sharpened tooth, at the cost of your vote. The silver charm is retired. Aimed items (aim field) take a second, server-private action (p/aim); aim "self" means the buyer declares they used it. The werebear may buy anything. Economy: 50 XLM buy-in, +15 XLM/day.

items.label: Horseshoe nail
items.effect: Lucky iron: if the vote ties on you, the tie falls on the other. One nail, one escape.

items.label: Cold iron key
items.flavor: Fits more doors than it should.
items.effect: Aim it: one villager finds one store locked to them tomorrow. The village learns which store was locked, never who turned the key.

general_store.label: General Store
general_store.subtitle: Everything you need. Nothing you can explain.

items.label: Shopkeeper's holiday
items.flavor: Everyone deserves a rest. Tomorrow, ideally.
items.effect: Aim it: that shopkeeper closes tomorrow and sells to nobody. The whole village sees the shutters.

items.label: Sock in mouth
items.flavor: Clean, mostly. That is not the point.
items.effect: Aim it: that villager may still talk and defend themselves, but their vote does not count at today's trial.

items.label: Barrel of beer
items.flavor: Finish it and the night finishes you.
items.effect: Drink it and pass out: you cast no vote today, and NOTHING takes you in the night — not the beast, not even a sharpened tooth. The one sure escape in the village. The werebear is too big for beer to touch.

items.label: Soup bone
items.flavor: Somebody else's dog will love you for it.
items.effect: Aim it: leave the bone at another villager's gate. If the beast comes for you tonight, one chance in four it goes there instead.

items.label: The butcher's knife
items.effect: Conviction, sharpened: your vote counts twice at today's trial. Everyone hears a knife being ground; nobody knows whose.

items.label: Tooth sharpener
items.flavor: Ask no questions about the previous owner.
items.effect: Werebear: tonight your prey is caught wherever it hides — offerings fail, bones at gates fail; only a villager dead drunk in the road is beyond you. Villager: leave it out as an offering — an even chance the beast takes it and spares you.

items.label: Gerald's finger
items.flavor: The Order swears it is his. The Order swears a lot.

items.label: Unquiet rest
items.flavor: The Order accepts coin for almost anything.
items.effect: Pay the Order early: when you die, an even chance your ghost returns with a vote. Either way, the village is told.

items.label: The long candle
items.flavor: Burns all night. Sees about half of it.
items.effect: Aim it: an even chance the flame shows you truly whether that villager is the werebear. Otherwise it gutters and tells you nothing.
